titleEn: AI in greenhouse horticulture: making smart use of data
titleZh: 温室园艺中的人工智能：巧妙利用数据
summaryZh: 本文介绍人工智能在温室园艺中的应用进展，涵盖数据驱动种植管理、AI分析与预测、以及自主信息采集与处理的AI代理等方向。Argos项目展示了仅依靠数据和模型计算即可管理作物的可行性，对智慧畜牧从业者理解AI落地路径具有跨领域参考价值。
featuredReason: 虽然聚焦温室园艺，但文中关于数据驱动管理、AI预测与自主代理的思路可直接迁移至畜禽养殖场景，有助于智慧畜牧从业者把握AI落地的共性路径与跨行业借鉴价值。

AI in greenhouse horticulture: making smart use of data

 04-11 | Uncategorized

LinkedInFacebookXWhatsAppPrint

The Argos programme shows that crops can be managed using data and model-based calculations alone. Photo: Peter Visser

 Smart digital applications are increasingly taking shape in greenhouse horticulture. AI applications can help growers analyse business data, predict developments and improve crop production processes. The next step is to use AI agents that collect and process information independently. The possibilities offered by data and artificial intelligence (AI) are constantly expanding. For growers, the challenge is to integrate them effectively into their operations. Asking ChatGPT a standalone quest
